integrity: The analytical proof is reproduced in RESULT.md; a self-contained finite checker corroborates identities and finite-section behaviour but is not a substitute for the infinite proof. No independent mathematical verification.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive weights, complex Hilbert ell2, two boundary defects and exact two-periodic tail; positive critical t required for onset. Priority of general Jacobi methods remains uncertain; full motivating preprint unavailable.
title: A sharp boundary-defect phase diagram for two-periodic unilateral weighted shifts
